An ordinary stint ahead, some small changes
The subject is paperwork queues

Travelers should know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk is making a few small changes to how paperwork is handled, with care for both pets and their people.

If you are preparing to travel with a companion animal, please bring your forms early and keep copies with you. <<FACT F118>> We also ask travelers to check crate labels, contact details, and travel papers before arrival so the desk can help without delay. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and our team will always guide you with calm, clear steps before departure.

If something seems uncertain, please speak with the desk before you leave for the terminal. A short visit or call can prevent avoidable problems, and it helps us keep things smooth for you and for your pet. We welcome questions in a warm and professional way, and we will do our best to support each traveler with care.

Please visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help with any travel paperwork.
